verdict.rationale: Attestation at registration is a fair question for a FIDO security key, but the evidence never documents attestation certificates or any way for a relying party or admin to verify key make or model and restrict enrollment to approved models. The hardware-chip integrity claims cover the key checking its own firmware for tampering, and the cryptographic-proof claim covers origin binding and possession. Both are adjacent features, not registration-time model attestation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can verify device attestation at registration to enforce that only genuine, approved key models are enrolled
